Linera raised $12M from a16z to build the "real-time blockchain"
then spent two years milking its community with tasks, and couldn't raise $850.000 from them at the end
2022
- founded by Mathieu Baudet, ex-Meta researcher who worked on Diem
- the pitch: microchains, a separate chain for every user
- June 2022: $6M seed led by a16z crypto
2023
- August: another $6M, $12M total
- the community starts farming
September 2025: Testnet Conway
- public testnet + points program
- 10M+ tasks, 281K+ users in about a month
and then the tasks never stopped
- puzzles, games, badges, leaderboards
- Discord roles, community hours, weekly competitions
- every phase came with a new grind
- no TGE date, no allocation details, just "keep going"
2026: the pivot
- the L1 story wasn't selling anymore
- Linera rebrands as "infrastructure for gamified finance"
- February: Linera Markets, 1-minute prediction markets
- March: open beta, more weekly competitions, more tasks
meanwhile mainnet was always "coming soon"
August 2026: the ask
- after two years of free labor from testers, they open a $LNRA community round
- $1.5M minimum
- commitment credits up to 50x, airdrop boosts, "one of the cheapest L1 sales ever"
- mainnet "targeting next month"
translation: the people who farmed for free were now asked to pay
September 9, 2026
- $848K from 617 people
- target missed, everything refunded
September 18, 2026
- emergency funding fails
- Linera shuts down, effective immediately
no TGE, no airdrop, no mainnet
281K users, millions of tasks, $12M from a16z, and testers walk away with a Discord role
two years of "just one more task" was never a roadmap, it was a delay

telegram:airdrops_io/7919.text:
Abstract had 4 million wallets, Pudgy Penguins behind it and $11M from Founders Fund
it's shutting down without ever giving its users a token
2024
- Igloo, the company behind Pudgy Penguins, announces Abstract
- a consumer L2 "for the next billion users"
- July 2024: raises $11M+ led by Founders Fund
- the pitch: PENGU energy, mainstream brands, onchain apps for normal people
January 2025: mainnet
- Abstract Portal goes live
- XP system + badges for every app you use
- streams, games, mints, prediction markets, all rewarding XP
- the whole chain is built around one loop: use apps, earn XP, climb tiers
and everyone knew what XP usually means
2025–2026: the grind
- users bridge ETH in and burn it on gas, mints and games
- weekly XP drops, badge hunting, tier chasing
- 4M wallets, 325M transactions, $6B in DEX volume
- $40M in ecosystem revenue, a big part of it straight from the community's pockets
- brand deals with Red Bull Racing and Disney
- 144+ apps deployed
meanwhile, behind the scenes
- core dev activity reportedly stalls in mid-2026
- senior team members reportedly leave in August
- October 1: Abstract branding quietly disappears from leadership profiles
October 6, 2026
- Igloo announces Abstract is shutting down
- "tens of millions" lost over 18 months
- reasons: thin liquidity, weak DeFi, no institutions, consumer model "unsustainable"
- deadline: bridge everything out before December 15 or lose it
and the XP?
- no token
- no airdrop
- no word on what XP or badges are worth
Luca Netz: "even after losing 8 figures, we could have launched a token... ultimately we decided against this"
so the team decided not to dump a token on users 
but the users already paid, in ETH, in gas, in mints, in months of grinding a points system that only ever made sense with a token at the end 
and some of them aren't letting it go quietly 
the same night, @degenlegendmfer, who says he's a lawyer irl, posts a formal statement: 
- calls it "one of the most serious frauds" in crypto 
- says he'll bring top US law firms to file a criminal complaint or civil action against @LucaNetz, @IglooInc and anyone involved
- invites every affected user to DM him and join the group 
- offers Igloo "good-faith negotiations" first, or court "without delay" 26K views and counting
26K views and counting
whether it ever reaches a courtroom is another story
but 4M wallets that farmed XP for a token that was never coming won't forget this one
Igloo goes back to PENGU
the community gets a bridge link, a deadline, and maybe a lawsuit
bridge out before Dec 15: migrate.abs.xyz

raw.actions: Create Account, Link Wallet & Trade
raw.description: Acepyr is a pre-mainnet prediction market that prices questions most platforms will not list. Venues like Polymarket trade events with a scheduled outcome. Acepyr settles those the same way, against a verifiable fact, then adds meta-markets on arguments and beliefs that never get a clean verdict. Traders take positions with testnet $ACEPYR, and the balance doubles as a public record of how well they read the world.
raw.name: Acepyr
steps: Step 1: Create Your Acepyr Account: Sign up at Acepyr with an email and password, entering referral code PW34SD3C2J during registration. Codes only count when applied at signup. Verify your email to activate the account.

Step 2: Accept the Legal Documents and Complete Onboarding: First login walks you through the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Testnet Points Notice, then the onboarding survey. Those steps plus your first sign-in pay 300 testnet $ACEPYR.

Step 3: Link a Wallet You Control: In Settings, link a wallet by signing a message; a pasted address does not qualify. One address links to one account permanently, and linking pays 500 testnet $ACEPYR.

Step 4: Join the Mainnet Waitlist: The most productive click on the platform. Joining needs a proven wallet holding at least the current minimum, now $10, read live across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BSC. Native coins and major stablecoins count, and nothing is sent to Acepyr, so balances you already hold for Base , Arbitrum or Optimism farming clear the check. Joining pays…

Step 5: Trade the Live Up or Down Markets: Take Up or Down on a five-minute window and let the price feed settle it. Three first-time achievements sit here: Open your first position: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Place your first limit order: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Close your first profitable position: 300 testnet $ACEPYR

Step 6: Enter the Weekly Tournament: Entry is free and individual, with no ticket and no minimum balance. One settled trade that week makes you valid and earns a share of the 10,000 testnet $ACEPYR pool.
Step 7: Build a Sign-In Streak: The streak pays at five rungs: 50 at two days, 100 at three, 300 at seven, 500 at fourteen and 1,000 at thirty. Each rung banks permanently.
Step 8: Generate Your Referral Code: Open Profile, then Referrals. Codes reset every month and points do not carry over.

analysis.summary:
艾瑪迪斯協議是一個專為代理金融而構建的機密第一層區塊鏈，人工智慧代理在其中進行鏈上交易、結算和協調。它的原生代幣是$AMA。它執行在有用的工作量證明（uPoW）上，這是一種共識模型，將挖掘能力指向真正的人工智慧運算而不是任意雜湊。
代理在具有可信任執行環境 (TEE) 隱私的確定性執行時內執行，因此它們的邏輯在保持可審計的同時保持私密性。該代幣的硬上限為 1,000,000,000，透過挖礦和質押而不是預挖來發行。

raw.actions: Create Wallet, Complete Check-In, Finish Social Tasks
raw.description:
Amadeus Protocol is a confidential Layer-1 blockchain built for agentic finance, where AI agents trade, settle, and coordinate on-chain. Its native token is $AMA. It runs on Useful Proof of Work (uPoW), a consensus model that points mining power at real AI computation instead of arbitrary hashing.
Agents run inside a deterministic runtime with Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) privacy, so their logic stays private while remaining auditable. The token has a hard cap of 1,000,000,000 and is emitted through mining and staking rather than a premine.
raw.name: Amadeus Protocol
steps: Step 1: Connect a Wallet: Open the AMA Hub quests page and connect an EVM wallet such as MetaMask, Rabby, or Trust. This is the address your PRIME Points are paid to.

Step 2: Create Your Amadeus Wallet: Install the Amadeus Wallet browser extension and set it up. This wallet holds $AMA and runs your sealed agents, and creating it is one of the larger one-off point rewards in the season.

Step 3: Link Both Wallets: Sign once from each wallet to connect them. The link tells the season that your chain address and Amadeus account belong to the same person, and quests stay locked until both are added.
Step 4: Complete the Daily Check-In: Return each day and claim the check-in on the quests page. Daily points reset and do not carry over, so steady visits matter more than any single session.

Step 5: Build and Deploy an Agent: Create an agent on AMA Hub and put it to work. These build quests are read directly from the chain, so nothing needs to be submitted. To earn across more of them: Add a skill to your agent so it can act Run an agent trade or swap on the network Claim a username for your account

Step 6: Finish the Social Quests: Complete the social tasks, which the campaign verifies within a few minutes: Follow Amadeus on X Join the Amadeus Discord Engage with the pinned launch post Record a short video explainer for the largest social reward

raw.description:
Ammora is liquidity infrastructure for onchain markets on GIWA , the Ethereum Layer 2 built by Dunamu, the South Korean company behind the Upbit exchange. Instead of stopping at token launch, Ammora connects market creation, swap routing, programmable liquidity and fee distribution in one onchain system, so a new asset has trading depth from its first buy.

raw.name: Ammora
steps: Step 1: Add GIWA Sepolia to your wallet: Open MetaMask or another EVM wallet and add GIWA Sepolia, chain ID 91342.

Step 2: Claim GIWA Sepolia test ETH: Request test ETH from the Lambda256 faucet linked on Ammora’s mission page. The liquidity mission has a 0.001 ETH minimum and gas on GIWA is negligible, so you need very little.

Step 3: Join the Ammora waitlist: Go to the Ammora waitlist , connect your wallet, sign the message and register an email. Every mission stays locked until this is done, and the wallet you use will be publicly tied to the leaderboard.
Step 4: Follow @AmmoraHQ on X: Follow the official Ammora account from the X account you want credited, then return to the dashboard to verify for 100 AP.
Step 5: Retweet the pinned post: Repost the pinned campaign post from the same X account for another 100 AP.
Step 6: Publish the daily X post: The dashboard fills in the post text for you, so this takes seconds. At 200 AP it is the highest paying repeatable mission.

Step 7: Supply test ETH liquidity: Press Supply on the daily liquidity mission and deposit at least 0.001 GIWA Sepolia test ETH into the Ammora vault. Each verified supply pays 50 AP. Repeat it daily.

Step 8: Clear the Launch Week bonus: Complete all five missions once during Launch Week, meaning joining, following, retweeting, posting and supplying. It is the largest single chunk of points available and it disappears when the window closes.
Step 9: Share your referral link: Open the referral tab on the waitlist page and copy your link. Each signup credits 200 AP up to a cap of five, so 1,000 AP is on the table.

步驟 2：在建築師計劃中賺取積分：建築師計劃在 Arc House 內部執行，沒有任何應用程式。積分來自於經批准的貢獻，例如內容、活動出席、社群幫助和專案，它們可以幫助您提升等級和徽章。在提交任何內容之前請先閱讀貢獻規則。

步驟 4： 用 USDC 為您的錢包充值：您需要一小筆 USDC 餘額用於 Gas，並需要一筆較大的 USDC 餘額用於 DeFi。在 Bybit 上購買 USDC 並在 Arc 網路上提取，或使用 Arc Portal 從另一條鏈上轉移 USDC。如果您的資金位於不同的鏈上或另一個代幣中，請使用下面的小部件將它們橋接或交換到 Arc。

raw.actions: Join Mainnet Activities
raw.description:
Arc is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 blockchain developed by Circle (the company behind USDC). It’s designed as an “Economic OS for the internet” to connect programmable money with real-world economic activity, focusing on on-chain lending, capital markets, FX, payments, and tokenized real-world assets.
Key features include deterministic sub-second finality, stablecoins (USDC) as native gas for predictable transaction costs, and opt-in privacy. The public testnet launched October 28, 2025, with 100+ institutional participants, including BlackRock, Visa, HSBC, Anthropic, and AWS.
raw.name: Arc
steps: Step 1: Join Arc House: Register on Arc House with your email or LinkedIn account and complete your profile. Arc House is the free official hub for events, hackathons and regional chapters.

Step 2: Earn Points in the Architects Program: The Architects Program runs inside Arc House and has no application. Points come from approved contributions such as content, event attendance, community help and projects, and they move you up through tiers and badges. Read the contribution rules before submitting anything.

Step 3: Add Arc Mainnet to Your Wallet: Rabby and MetaMask support Arc. You can connect through the Arc docs or add the network manually: Network name: Arc RPC URL: https://rpc.mainnet.arc.io Chain ID: 5042 Currency symbol: USDC Block explorer: https://explorer.arc.io Networks listing ARC as the gas symbol are not Circle’s Arc.

Step 4: Fund Your Wallet with USDC: You need a small USDC balance for gas and a larger one for DeFi. Buy USDC on Bybit and withdraw it on the Arc network, or move USDC from another chain with Arc Portal . If your funds sit on a different chain or in another token, use the widget below to bridge or swap them to Arc.
Step 5: Swap on Arc DEXs: Trade USDC, EURC and cirBTC on Uniswap or on Arc-native venues such as Synthra and UnitFlow . Synthra also runs its own confirmed points program for liquidity and trading.

Step 6: Lend or Borrow Stablecoins: Supply USDC or EURC to the Aave V4 market or a Morpho vault on Arc. A position held over several weeks builds a longer history than a single deposit and withdrawal.
Step 7: Trade Stablecoin FX on Hibachi: Trade stablecoin FX or perps on Hibachi , which brings FX price discovery to Arc.

Step 8: Build a Project with Arc Studio: Developers can generate and deploy an app with Arc Studio , Circle’s onchain coding agent. Shipped projects also earn Architects points when you submit them in Arc House. Builders without capital can still test for free on Arc testnet (Chain ID 5042002) with USDC from the Circle faucet .

raw.actions: Sign Up, Trade & Collect Points
raw.description:
Arcus is a decentralized exchange built by the dYdX Labs team in partnership with Robinhood Crypto. It runs on Robinhood Chain and lets users trade more than 95 tokenized stock tokens around the clock with zero fees on spot trades.
Beyond spot, Arcus is rolling out perpetual futures covering equities, crypto, commodities, and indices. The platform is self-custodial, and tokenized stocks can be used as collateral for perps. Arcus launched spot trading in beta on July 1, 2026, with perps still in a closed beta and waitlist phase.
raw.name: Arcus
steps: Step 1: Sign Up on Arcus: Go to Arcus and connect your wallet or sign up with Google. Signing up through our link gives you 5% off trading fees. Arcus is not available in the US, Canada, the UK, and other restricted jurisdictions.
Step 2: Deposit Funds: Deposit USDC, USDT, BTC, or another supported asset into your Arcus account. You can buy these on Bybit , then move them to Robinhood Chain with the bridge widget below.

Step 3: Trade Stock Tokens on Spot: Open the spot market and trade any of the 95+ stock tokens. Spot trades carry no fees, and stock tokens currently earn boosted points. Trading outside regular US market hours adds a further boost. If you use Robinhood Wallet, swaps routed through Arcus also qualify for boosted spot points.

Step 4: Unlock Perps With an Invite Code: Perps now require an invite code from an existing Arcus trader. Connect your wallet on Arcus and enter the code when prompted. Traders who already had access don’t need one.
Step 5: Keep Collateral on the Exchange: Retained deposits count toward Season 1 points. Leaving collateral on Arcus between trades scores better than depositing and withdrawing each session.
Step 6: Track Your Points: Open the Points Dashboard to see your weekly Season 1 points and your Season 0 leaderboard rank. New points land every Wednesday at 3PM EST.

Step 7: Share Your Invite Codes: Every $1M in perps volume earns you an invite code, and volume from traders you referred counts toward that total. Find your codes under Rewards > Referrals. Anyone who signs up with your code becomes your referral, and their trading adds to your referral points bonus.

steps: 步驟 1：在 Axis Hub 上建立帳戶：前往 Axis Hub 並使用電子郵件、Google、X 或錢包進行註冊。
步驟 2：完成預訓練任務：從 Hub 中選擇一個任務，例如在廚房或家庭場景中拾取、放置或堆疊物體，並引導模擬手臂透過它。我們將根據您的簡報是否成功、效率和動作流暢度來評判。失敗的嘗試永遠不會被上傳，也不會受到任何懲罰，因此請重試，直到執行感覺乾淨為止。
步驟 3：承擔訓練後任務：這裡，訓練有素的策略會在您觀看時嘗試執行該任務，只有在失敗時您才能獲得控制權。會話有 30 秒的接管預算：未完成的嘗試得分為零，而執行策略未受影響的得分最高。故障點簡短、精確的修正效果最佳。
步驟 4：在鏈上簽署您的提交內容：開啟您的作品集並在 Base 上簽署每項已完成的任務。簽名使提交內容計入 Axis 積分。
步驟 5：跨場景和技能分散您的任務：多樣性是透過兩個軸來衡量的，即您的任務涵蓋的場景和他們所運用的技能，因此要對兩者進行變化，而不是重複一種組合。 Hub 也將每個帳戶的每項任務限制為 5 次完成，超過上限的任何任務都將被排除在評分之外。
步驟 6：加入聯盟任務以獲得合作夥伴獎勵：檢視聯盟部分，以瞭解與 BitRobot 等生態系統合作夥伴建立的任務。這些活動會根據活動條款支付安訊士積分和合作夥伴獎勵，這是每次會談的最佳價值。
第 7 步：邀請保持活躍的貢獻者：分享您在中心的推薦連結。只有直接受邀者才算數，而且只能透過他們產生的成果來計算，因此十個不活躍的註冊者一無所獲，而一名穩定的貢獻者則持續付費。
analysis.summary:
Axis Robotics 是一個實體 AI 眾包資料平臺，位於 Base 上。它無需使用昂貴的硬體收集機器人訓練資料，而是允許任何人在瀏覽器中遠端操作模擬機器人手臂。每個會話都被記錄為軌跡，由自動化管道進行評分，並在進入訓練機器人模型之前記錄在鏈上以查詢來源。
該專案於 2026 年 7 月籌集了 1,200 萬美元種子輪融資，由 Hack VC 與 Nomad Capital、Pi Network Ventures 和 10K Ventures 領投。

raw.actions: Complete Pre-Training Tasks, Sign Your Submissions & Refer to Earn
raw.description:
Axis Robotics is a crowdsourced data platform for physical AI, live on Base . Instead of collecting robot training data with expensive hardware, it lets anyone teleoperate a simulated robot arm in the browser. Each session is recorded as a trajectory, scored by an automated pipeline, and logged on-chain for provenance before it goes into training robot models.
The project raised a $12M seed round in July 2026, led by Hack VC with Nomad Capital, Pi Network Ventures, and 10K Ventures.
raw.name: Axis Robotics
steps: Step 1: Create an Account on Axis Hub: Go to the Axis Hub and sign up with email, Google, X, or a wallet.

Step 2: Complete Pre-Training Tasks: Pick a task from the Hub, such as picking, placing, or stacking objects in a kitchen or home scene, and steer the simulated arm through it. Your demonstration is judged on success, efficiency, and motion smoothness. Failed attempts are never uploaded and carry no penalty, so retry until the run feels clean.

Step 3: Take On Post-Training Tasks: Here a trained policy attempts the task while you watch, and you grab control only when it fails. Sessions have a 30-second takeover budget: incomplete attempts score zero, while runs the policy finishes untouched score highest. Short, precise corrections at the failure point score best.
Step 4: Sign Your Submissions On-Chain: Open your Portfolio and sign each completed task on Base. Signing is what makes a submission count toward Axis Points.

Step 5: Spread Your Tasks Across Scenarios and Skills: Diversity is measured on two axes, the scenes your tasks cover and the skills they exercise, so vary both rather than repeating one combo. The Hub also caps each task at 5 completions per account, and anything past the cap is excluded from scoring.

Step 6: Join Alliance Tasks for Partner Rewards: Check the Alliance section for tasks built with ecosystem partners such as BitRobot. These pay Axis Points plus a partner reward under campaign terms, the best value per session when one is live.

Step 7: Invite Contributors Who Will Stay Active: Share your referral link from the Hub. Only direct invitees count, and only through what they produce, so ten inactive signups earn you nothing while one steady contributor keeps paying.

步驟 5：交易代幣化股票以獲得提升積分：如果您所在的司法管轄區有代幣化股票，請在 BaiBai 上兌換。這些交易暫時獲得了 2 倍積分提升，因此請先確認乘數仍在執行。

analysis.summary:
BaiBai 是由 Spire Labs 打造的 Base 上的 PropAMM 交易所和流動性聚合器，其新的積分計劃已使其成為潛在的 BaiBai 空投的關注物件。在百百上，專業做市商根據自己的定價邏輯和庫存來報價，而不是依賴被動的流動性池，旨在為交易者提供更窄的點差。

raw.actions: Trade, Swap and Refer to Earn Points
raw.description:
BaiBai is a PropAMM exchange and liquidity aggregator on Base, built by Spire Labs, and its new points program has put it on the radar for a potential BaiBai airdrop. On BaiBai, professional market makers quote prices from their own pricing logic and inventory instead of relying on passive liquidity pools, which aims to give traders tighter spreads.
Trading is gasless, since you only sign the order and the platform covers network fees. After a closed alpha, BaiBai opened to the public on August 12, 2026.
raw.name: BaiBai
steps: Step 1: Visit the BaiBai App: Go to the BaiBai app and click “Connect Wallet.” Switch your wallet to the Base network if it isn’t there already.

Step 2: Fund Your Wallet With USDC or ETH on Base: You need USDC or ETH on Base to trade. You can buy either asset on Bybit and withdraw directly to Base. Holding funds on another chain? Move them over with the bridge widget below.

Step 3: Make Your First Swap: Pick the token you want to sell and the one you want to buy, enter an amount, and review the quote. Click “Trade,” approve the token if prompted, and sign. No gas is needed.

Step 4: Trade Regularly to Build Points: Points are based on trading volume and activity. Spread trades across different days and token pairs instead of placing one large swap, and check the app for any active multipliers before you trade.

Step 5: Trade Tokenized Stocks for Boosted Points: If tokenized stocks are available in your jurisdiction, swap into them on BaiBai. These trades have earned a temporary 2x points boost, so confirm the multiplier is still running first.
Step 6: Share Your Rekt Receipt: Visit the BaiBai Rekt page , generate your receipt, and share it to collect bonus points.
Step 7: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link: Open the Points page and copy your referral link. You earn 10% of the points your referrals generate, and they receive a 10% points boost.

raw.description:
BULK is a decentralized perpetuals exchange built on Solana , designed to deliver CEX-level trading speed in a fully on-chain environment. The platform runs an ultra-low latency orderbook and a custom execution layer integrated directly with Solana validators, targeting traders who want leveraged crypto derivatives without giving up self-custody or censorship resistance.
The project closed an $8 million seed round in September 2025, co-led by Robot Ventures and 6th Man Ventures. Backers include Wintermute Ventures, Mirana Ventures, and Chapter One, with Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko participating as an angel investor. raw.description:
Cambria is a browser-based risk-to-earn MMO where players stake real assets on skill-based loot runs, duels, and seasonal extraction events. The game combines three core modes: Dungeons, a Diablo-style dungeon crawler now in early access; Duel Arena, a PvP wagering hub where players stake ETH or in-game tokens on 1v1 fights; and Gold Rush, a seasonal RuneScape-inspired extraction mode where players risk gear to loot territory and cash out.
The studio has raised roughly $4.5 million : a $2.5 million seed round co-led by BITKRAFT Ventures and 1kx, a $2 million strategic round co-led by BITKRAFT and Sky Mavis, and a $1 million public sale that priced RSGP at a $30 million FDV. Dungeons is now in early access, and $RSGP is unlaunched.
raw.name: Cambria
steps: Step 1: Create Your Cambria Account: Visit the Cambria lobby and set up an account. Use invite code 9df14149 at sign-up, which gives both you and the referrer a points boost on future activity.

Step 2: Link Your Wallets: Connect an EVM wallet, a Solana wallet, and an Abstract wallet from your account settings. Cambria checks activity across all three when it calculates your Degen and Chad Scores, so linking all of them matters even if you only plan to play on one chain.

Step 3: Check Your Loot Chests Eligibility: Once your wallets are linked, head to the claims dashboard to see your Degen Score and Chad Score, along with any Loot Chests you’ve already qualified for. Your Care Package size scales based on your degen score across: Solana trading activity (memecoins, DeFi, prediction markets) Polymarket trading activity Multi-chain risk-taking (perps, options, NFT…

Step 4: Claim Your Loot Chests: Claim available chests from the lobby within the 14-day claim window. Chests convert into $RSGP allocations, and anything tied to an eligible wallet is also sent automatically at TGE.
Step 5: Fund Your Wallet for Gameplay: Playing Dungeons and Gold Rush takes USDC or ETH for Risk Keys and in-game costs.

Step 6: Play Dungeons for Loot and Points: Buy a Risk Key for about 0.1 USDC and run a dungeon. Extract successfully and you keep the loot; die inside and you lose the key’s stake. Loot you cash out at the Royal Treasury converts into Genesis Airdrop points on top of any in-game currency.

Step 7: Earn Points Through Duel Arena and Side Activities: Duel Arena lets you wager directly against other players in 1v1 fights, and side activities like Pit Fights, island fishing, and bar games generate smaller, steady point drips between bigger runs.

Step 8: Mint a Royal Charter for Full Seasonal Earning: During Gold Rush seasons, minting a Royal Charter unlocks full earning features and daily energy regeneration. Without one, you can still play, but your point accumulation is capped.

raw.actions: Connect wallet & Claim Tokens
raw.description:
CZR Exchange is a centralized crypto exchange headquartered in the Cayman Islands. It combines spot and futures trading, copy trading, automated strategies, staking and swaps on one platform, alongside the non-custodial CZR Wallet. Its native token, CZR, is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum, and the CZR airdrop claim is now open ahead of the October 1, 2026 token launch.
CZR is designed to tie the ecosystem together through trading fee discounts, staking and Earn products, VIP benefits and Launchpad access. Before the launch, CZR Exchange sold its initial $2 million public-sale allocation in under an hour and followed it with a $500,000 round.
The airdrop tokens come from CZR FNDN LTD, a foundation that operates separately from the exchange and manages community token allocations.
raw.name: CZR
steps: Step 1: Open the Official CZR Claim Page: Go to the CZR claim page on the airdrop.czrex.com domain. Genesis and Quest participants both claim here. Ignore claim links sent through DMs, comments or search ads, and read our airdrop safety guide if you are unsure about a site.
Step 2: Check Your Eligibility: Paste your wallet address into the eligibility checker and click “Check.” Use the Ethereum wallet you connected during the Genesis campaign or the Quest program.

Step 3: Get ETH for the Claim Fee: The claim is an Ethereum transaction, so you need a small amount of ETH on Ethereum mainnet for gas. You can buy ETH on Bybit , or bridge and swap funds from another chain to Ethereum with the widget below.
Step 4: Connect Your Eligible Wallet: Click “Connect Wallet” and approve the connection in MetaMask, Rabby or another Ethereum wallet. The page shows your CZR allocation once the wallet is connected.
Step 5: Claim Your CZR: Click the claim button and confirm the transaction in your wallet before the window closes on October 5, 2026.
Step 6: Wait for the October 11 Unlock: Airdropped CZR stays locked for 10 days after the October 1 launch. Until October 11, you cannot sell, trade, transfer or withdraw it.

Step 7: Trade CZR on CZR Exchange: CZR/USDT spot trading opens on CZR Exchange on October 1. CZR deposits and withdrawals on the exchange stay paused until October 11 at 1:00 PM Singapore time, while trading itself remains open.

steps: 步驟 1：將您的錢包連線到 Dow Points 儀錶板：開啟 Dow Protocol 積分頁面並連線錢包。 BNB Chain 是 XP 追蹤的主要網路。 BNB Chain：MetaMask、Rabby 或任何 EVM 錢包都適用於主儀錶板 Sui：如果您打算使用 Volo 金庫，您也可以繫結 Sui 錢包
步驟 2：連結您的 X 帳戶：從任務清單中連結 X 即可獲得 50 XP。這會限制其他一切，因為發布任務和推薦層都需要一個連結的 X 帳戶。
步驟 3：發布有關 Dow Protocol 的文章並提交審核：在 X 上發布有關 Dow 的帖子，然後透過儀錶板提交連結以供批准。支付 50 XP 並解鎖推薦。寫一些關於金庫或應收帳款模型的具體內容，因為經過審核的任務拒絕複製貼上填充。
步驟 4： 連結 Telegram 和 Discord：從任務清單連線兩個帳戶，每個帳戶 50 XP。一次性任務，大約需要一分鐘的時間。
步驟 5：將穩定幣存入開放金庫：當 Dow Protocol 應用程式上開啟訂閱視窗時，將穩定幣存入 BNB Chain 上的陶氏電子商務融資金庫或 Sui 上的 Dowsure Stable #1。保險庫的有效期為 90 天，因此請先圍繞鎖進行規劃。您可以在 Bybit 上購買穩定幣並提取它們，或者使用下面的小部件從另一個鏈轉移資金。
步驟 6：分享您的推薦連結：您的貼文透過審核後，儀錶板會產生邀請連結。每次經過驗證的註冊都會增加推薦 XP，而推薦是唯一可以超越一次性付款的任務。
步驟 7： 追蹤任務 XP 和建議 XP：您的餘額分為任務 XP、推薦 XP 和執行總計。每次任務後檢查以確認註冊的積分，因為社交驗證有時需要重新整理。
analysis.summary:
Dow Protocol 是一個電子商務融資 RWA 平臺，為跨境商家提供鏈上流動資金借貸。亞馬遜和類似市場上的賣家需要等待 14 到 28 天才能清算銷售收入，而庫存、廣告和物流帳單則不斷收到。陶氏化學針對那些待處理的應收帳款預支穩定幣資金，然後自動從商家的平臺餘額收取還款。
陶氏化學於 2026 年 8 月 7 日宣佈籌集 1,050 萬美元種子輪融資，由 MH Ventures、Mapleblock、Animoca Brands、Arcane Group、HSKChain、Essentia Partners 和 Quartet Group 提供支援。金庫透過 BNB Chain 上的 Lista DAO 和 Sui 上的 Volo 實現。

raw.actions: Connect X, Publish a Post, Refer Friends
raw.description:
Dow Protocol is an e-commerce financing RWA platform that moves working capital lending for cross-border merchants on-chain. Sellers on Amazon and similar marketplaces wait 14 to 28 days for sales proceeds to clear, while inventory, advertising and logistics bills keep arriving. Dow advances stablecoin funding against those pending receivables, then collects repayment automatically from the merchant’s platform balance.
Dow raised a $10.5 million seed round announced on August 7, 2026, backed by MH Ventures, Mapleblock, Animoca Brands, Arcane Group, HSKChain, Essentia Partners and Quartet Group. Vaults are live through Lista DAO on BNB Chain and Volo on Sui.
raw.name: Dow Protocol
steps: Step 1: Connect Your Wallet to the Dow Points Dashboard: Open the Dow Protocol points page and connect a wallet. BNB Chain is the primary network for XP tracking. BNB Chain: MetaMask, Rabby or any EVM wallet works for the main dashboard Sui: bind a Sui wallet too if you plan to use the Volo vault
Step 2: Connect Your X Account: Link X from the quest list for 50 XP. This gates everything else, since both the posting quest and the referral tier need a connected X account.

Step 3: Post About Dow Protocol and Submit It for Review: Publish a post about Dow on X, then submit the link through the dashboard for approval. That pays 50 XP and unlocks referrals. Write something specific about the vault or the receivables model, since reviewed quests reject copy-paste filler.
Step 4: Link Telegram and Discord: Connect both accounts from the quest list for 50 XP each. One-time quests, about a minute of work.

Step 5: Deposit Stablecoins Into an Open Vault: When a subscription window opens on the Dow Protocol app, deposit stablecoins into the Dow E-Commerce Financing Vault on BNB Chain or Dowsure Stable #1 on Sui. Vaults run a 90-day term, so plan around the lock first. You can buy stablecoins on Bybit and withdraw them, or move funds from another chain with the widget below.

Step 6: Share Your Referral Link: Once your post clears review, the dashboard generates an invite link. Each verified signup adds Referral XP, and referrals are the only quest that scales past a one-time payout.

Step 7: Track Task XP and Referral XP: Your balance splits into Task XP, Referral XP and a running total. Check after each quest to confirm points registered, since social verifications sometimes need a refresh.

steps: Step 1: Sign Up for UPTIME with Your Email: Go to the UPTIME campaign page and enter the email address you want tied to your points. Balances are held on the waitlist server, so the same address works from any device.

Step 6: Connect Your X Account When Linking Opens: X connection is not available yet. The dashboard says it opens before Epoch 1 closes and that nothing is lost by waiting, so check back rather than hunting for a workaround.
Step 7: Check the Leaderboard: The leaderboard shows your rank, your share of the leader’s total, and a breakdown of how you got there. Use it to find routes you have not completed.

steps: 步驟 1：將您的錢包連線到 Extended：開啟 Extended 應用程式並連線 EVM 或 Starknet 錢包。 EVM 使用者從不直接接觸 Starknet，因為存款和提款是透過下面列出的網路進行的。
步驟 2： 讓 USDC 準備好存款：USDC 為 Extended 上的所有內容提供資金，從交易抵押品到金庫存款。在 Bybit 上購買並提取到支援的網路，或者如果您的資金已經位於另一條鏈上，請使用下面的小部件將其轉移。
步驟 3：存入您的擴充帳戶：EVM 錢包在以太坊、Arbitrum、Base、Polygon、Avalanche 和 BNB 鏈上存入和提取 USDC。 Starknet 錢包使用者從 Starknet 進行存款。 wBTC、ETH 和 USDT 也適用於其中一些網路，但 USDC 的覆蓋範圍最廣。
第四步：永續市場交易：交易是三個積分類別中最大的一個。 Extended 並未公佈確切的公式，但數量、一致性和真實訂單流都會納入其中。較清淡的市場通常比擁擠的主要市場每美元交易回報更多的積分，這適用於大多數 Perp DEX 積分計劃。
步驟 5：將 USDC 存入擴充套件金庫：金庫存款算作流動性供應，並在收益的同時賺取積分。在您投入資金之前值得了解的機制：最低存款為 5 美元，每筆存款都有 24 小時鎖定期 XVS 將其 90% 的價值貢獻給您的權益，並且可用交易餘額 XVS 目前無法從交易所提取，只能在…之間轉移。
步驟 6：解鎖您的推薦連結：交易量達到 10,000 美元後，您可以產生推薦連結。您可以賺取受邀者產生的積分的 2.5%，並且他們在首筆 5000 萬美元交易量中可以獲得 10% 的佣金折扣。具有提升積分和費用回饋的聯盟會員等級僅受邀請：您透過擴充套件團隊或現有聯盟會員加入。
步驟 7：每週二檢查您的積分：每週 00:00 UTC 分發，您的餘額和完整歷史記錄位於應用程式內的積分頁面上。每週檢查一次，顯示實際賺取的收入，並在計畫結束前留出調整的空間。
analysis.summary:
Extended 是一個基於 Starknet 構建的去中心化永續合約交易所，提供涵蓋加密貨幣、股票、外匯、大宗商品和指數的 100 多個市場，槓桿高達 100 倍。該平臺實施混合中央限價訂單簿 (CLOB) 模型，可在鏈外處理訂單和匹配交易，同時透過 Starknet 支援 zk 的基礎設施在鏈上結算交易。目前正在開發用於去中心化測序的特定於應用程式的鏈。
該架構使 Extended 能夠以降低的 Gas 費用提供高效能交易，同時透過 Starknet 基礎設施維護安全性。他們的混合方法最佳化了速度和成本效率，解決了常見問題

raw.actions: Deposit, Trade & refer friends to Earn Points
raw.description:
Extended is a decentralized perpetuals exchange built on Starknet, offering 100+ markets spanning crypto, equities, FX, commodities, and indices, with leverage up to 100x. The platform implements a hybrid Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) model that processes orders and matches trades off-chain while settling transactions on-chain through Starknet’s zk-enabled infrastructure. An app-specific chain for decentralized sequencing is currently in development.
This architecture enables Extended to deliver high-performance trading with reduced gas fees while maintaining security through Starknet’s infrastructure. Their hybrid approach optimizes for both speed and cost-efficiency, addressing common pain points in DeFi trading.
Extended was built by a team with backgrounds at Revolut and has secured $19 million in funding from investors including Cyber Fund, Semantic Ventures, and StarkWare.
raw.name: Extended
steps: Step 1: Connect Your Wallet to Extended: Open the Extended app and connect an EVM or Starknet wallet. EVM users never touch Starknet directly, since deposits and withdrawals run through the networks listed below.

Step 2: Get USDC Ready to Deposit: USDC funds everything on Extended, from trading collateral to vault deposits. Buy it on Bybit and withdraw to a supported network, or if your capital already sits on another chain, shift it across with the widget below.

Step 3: Deposit Into Your Extended Account: EVM wallets deposit and withdraw USDC on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base , Polygon, Avalanche and BNB Chain. Starknet wallet users deposit from Starknet. wBTC, ETH and USDT work on some of those networks too, but USDC has the widest coverage.

Step 4: Trade the Perpetual Markets: Trading is the largest of the three points categories. Extended does not publish the exact formula, but volume, consistency and genuine order flow all feed into it. Thinner markets usually return more points per dollar traded than the crowded majors, which holds across most perp DEX points programs .

Step 5: Deposit USDC Into the Extended Vault: Vault deposits count as liquidity provision and earn points alongside yield. Mechanics worth knowing before you commit capital: Minimum deposit is $5, and each deposit carries its own 24 hour lockup XVS contributes 90% of its value to your equity and available trading balance XVS cannot currently be withdrawn from the exchange, only moved between…

Step 6: Unlock Your Referral Link: After $10,000 in traded volume you can generate a referral link. You earn 2.5% of the points your invitees generate, and they get a 10% commission discount on their first $50 million of volume. The affiliate tier, with boosted points and fee rebates, is invite only: you join through the Extended team or an existing affiliate.

Step 7: Check Your Points Every Tuesday: Distributions land weekly at 00:00 UTC, and your balance and full history sit on the points page inside the app. Checking it weekly shows what actually earned and leaves room to adjust before the program ends.

步驟 6：領取每週 USDG 獎勵：每週開啟 Fables 上的獎勵面板並領取您的 USDG。獎勵是根據您當週的部位所賺取的掉期費用。
步驟 7：建立您的推薦連結：一旦您的職位價值至少為 100 美元，請在積分板上連線您的 X 帳戶以產生推薦連結。您將獲得每個受邀使用者獲得的 LP 積分的 10%。

raw.actions: Connect Wallet, Deposit & Provide Liquidity
raw.description:
Fables is a decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain built with Uniswap v4 hooks. It runs pair-specific markets for tokenized stocks, ETFs, and crypto, such as SPY/USDG, GLD/USDG, TSLA/USDG, and ETH/USDG. The Fables airdrop is tied to a points program for liquidity providers, and the planned token is $FABLES.
Fees on Fables are dynamic. Each market sets its swap fee based on risk, so LPs earn more when conditions are riskier, including around US market closures for tokenized stocks.
raw.name: Fables
steps: Step 1: Add Robinhood Chain to Your Wallet: Robinhood Wallet supports the chain by default (see our Robinhood Chain guide for setup basics). For MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet, add Robinhood Chain manually (chain ID 4663, ETH for gas).

Step 2: Fund Your Wallet With ETH or USDG: You need ETH for gas and either ETH or USDG to provide liquidity. Buy ETH on Bybit and withdraw it to your wallet, then move it onto Robinhood Chain or swap into USDG with the bridge widget below.
Step 3: Connect Your Wallet to Fables: Open Fables and connect your wallet. Using this link applies a referral, which does not reduce your own points.

Step 4: Deposit Liquidity Into a Fables Market: Go to the deposit section and choose an eligible market: ETH/USDG: crypto pair with round-the-clock trading SPY/USDG: tokenized S&P 500 ETF GLD/USDG: tokenized gold ETF TSLA/USDG: tokenized Tesla stock Pick a price range, enter your ETH or USDG amount, and confirm the transaction. Other supported tokens work too.

Step 5: Keep Your Position in Range: Positions earn swap fees, and therefore points, only while the price sits inside your range. Check your position regularly and adjust the range when the price moves out.
Step 6: Claim Weekly USDG Rewards: Open the rewards panel on Fables each week and claim your USDG. Rewards are based on the swap fees your positions earned that week.

Step 7: Create Your Referral Link: Once your position is worth at least $100, connect your X account on the Points Board to generate a referral link. You earn 10% of the LP points each invited user earns.

steps: 步驟 1：加入 GTE 候補名單：使用您的電子郵件在 GTE 候補名單上註冊，以獲取職位並解鎖積分任務。透過推薦連結加入也會使推薦人在佇列中上移，因此，如果您有朋友的連結，請使用朋友的連結。
步驟 2：保留您的 GTE 使用者名稱：領取您的帳號即可獲得 25 點積分。名稱由 3 到 15 個字元組成，使用字母、數字和底線，先到先得。保留後，該名稱將被鎖定到您的帳戶以及您在啟動時的帳戶，因此請先執行此操作。
步驟 3：驗證您的 X 和 Instagram 追蹤者：兩項社交任務，每項 25 分： X：透過候補名單連線您的 X 帳戶並追蹤 @GTE_XYZ Instagram：在候補名單上輸入您的 Instagram 使用者名稱，然後從同一帳戶追蹤 @gte.xyz 大約 24 小時後，這兩個任務都會獲得積分。支票與您提交的使用者名稱匹配，因此請按照您實際輸入的帳戶進行操作。
步驟 4：分享您的推薦連結：透過您的連結進行的每個經過驗證的註冊都將支付 100 積分，這比所有固定任務的總和還要多。在人們已經關注發布的地方分享它，因為一次性註冊往往會在這些系統上被過濾掉。
步驟 5：保留舊測試網錢包：如果您交易了原始 GTE 測試網，請保留該錢包，而不是合併它。這是該專案擁有的唯一重要的鏈上歷史，而追溯性的 Perp DEX 分佈通常是根據交易記錄來衡量的。
步驟 6： 準備主網交易：等待名單訪問是先開放任何 GTE 的入口點，無論是早期交易訪問還是積分季節。隨著發布的臨近，請回來檢視，因為第一個即時交易視窗可能比任何發布前的任務都更重要。
analysis.summary:
GTE是一個基於MegaETH構建的去中心化交易場所，旨在提供完整的交易生態系統。該平臺整合了多個交易元件，包括用於提供高品質流動性的無曲柄鏈上中央限價訂單簿（CLOB）、用於被動提供流動性的傳統自動做市商（AMM）以及掃描整個 MegaETH 生態系統以確保使用者獲得最佳交易價格的最佳價格聚合器。
GTE 的與眾不同之處在於其全面的交易基礎設施方法。該平臺提供了一個無需許可的代幣啟動器，具有聯合曲線功能，可將流動性引導到其 AMM 系統中，以及用於大型協議的專用啟動板

raw.description:
GTE is a decentralized trading venue built on MegaETH , designed to provide a complete trading ecosystem. The platform integrates multiple trading components including a crankless onchain central limit order book (CLOB) for high-quality liquidity, a traditional automated market maker (AMM) for passive liquidity provision, and a best-price aggregator that scans the entire MegaETH ecosystem to ensure users get optimal trading rates.
What sets GTE apart is its comprehensive approach to trading infrastructure. The platform offers a permissionless token launcher with bonding curve functionality to bootstrap liquidity into its AMM system, along with a dedicated launchpad for larger protocols looking to conduct their token generation events (TGEs).
GTE has successfully raised a total of $25.94 million in funding from prominent investors including Paradigm, Wintermute, and GSR.

steps: Step 1: Join the GTE Waitlist: Sign up on the GTE waitlist with your email to claim a position and unlock the point tasks. Joining through a referral link also moves the referrer up the queue, so use a friend’s link if you have one.

Step 2: Reserve Your GTE Username: Claim your handle for 25 points. Names run 3 to 15 characters using letters, numbers and underscores, and they are first come, first served. Once reserved, the name is locked to your account and yours at launch, so do this before anything else.

Step 3: Verify Your X and Instagram Follows: Two social tasks, 25 points each: X: connect your X account through the waitlist and follow @GTE_XYZ Instagram: enter your Instagram username on the waitlist, then follow @gte.xyz from that same account Both credit roughly 24 hours later. The check matches against the username you submitted, so follow from the accounts you actually entered.

Step 4: Share Your Referral Link: Every verified signup through your link pays 100 points, more than all the fixed tasks combined. Share it where people already follow launches, since throwaway signups tend to get filtered out on these systems.

Step 5: Keep Your Old Testnet Wallet: If you traded the original GTE testnet, hold that wallet instead of consolidating it away. It is the only substantial on-chain history the project has, and retroactive perp DEX distributions have generally been measured from trading records.

Step 6: Prepare for Mainnet Trading: Waitlist access is the entry point to whatever GTE opens first, whether that is early trading access or a points season. Check back as launch approaches, because the first live trading window will likely carry more weight than any pre-launch task.

steps: 步驟1：建立Kraken帳戶：在Kraken註冊並完成身份驗證。 Kraken Pro 活動直接計入 Ink 積分，因此活躍的經過驗證的帳戶是目前獲得資格的最確認途徑。
步驟2：在Kraken Pro上交易：開啟Kraken Pro並開始交易。積分透過 Kraken Pro 上的活動收集，每週一計算並新增，反映前一週的活動。對於現有使用者，積分從 2026 年 4 月 6 日開始。提升是賺取額外積分的限時方式，存入現金（2 倍積分）重新啟動獎金（3 倍積分）設定價格提醒（獎金提升）
步驟 3：設定 Kraken 錢包並將資金轉移到 Ink：下載 Kraken 錢包並切換到 Ink 網路。由於錢包支援第一方 Ink，因此將資產從 Kraken 轉移到 Ink 無需支付提現費用，而且轉帳速度很快。早期的 Kraken 錢包使用者可以從第一天開始透過交換代幣、購買 NFT 以及直接在…內與 Nado 和 Tydro 互動來賺取 $INK 積分。
步驟 4：在 Nado DEX 上進行交易：造訪 Nado DEX 並使用您的橋接資金執行交易。 Nado 上的鏈上交易活動可以獲得 Nado 積分，也被確認為 INK 空投的資格標準。
步驟 5：在 Tydro 上提供或借款：前往 Tydro 並提供資產以賺取收益或以抵押品借款。 Tydro 活動是 INK 空投的另一個已確認的資格標準。
步驟 6： 探索特色應用程式：檢視 Ink 主頁上的特色 dApp，包括 Velodrome、InkyPump 和 GM 簽到。在整個生態系中定期互動。跨多個應用程式的活動廣度往往比大量使用單一應用程式更重要。
步驟7：註冊.ink域名：透過 ZNS 註冊.ink域名。擁有網域將您的身分與 Ink 生態系統連結起來，並增加了另一種合格的互動。
步驟 8：在網路上傳送 GM：在 Ink 上傳送 GM給其他使用者。每個 GM 都算是鏈上的額外交易，為您的整體活動做出貢獻。
步驟 9：在 Ink 上部署智慧合約：使用 OnChainGM 在 Ink 上部署智慧合約。這是一個簡單的一鍵部署，可在您的地址上註冊合約互動。

raw.actions: Trade on Kraken Pro & Interact with Dapps
raw.description:
Ink is an Ethereum layer 2 blockchain built by Kraken on the OP Stack. Ink was made to be the Superchain’s home for DeFi, and its goal is to make on-chain finance available to the next billion users. The chain is a cheap and fast place to use and deploy DeFi protocols.
Ink is a key part of Kraken’s mission to speed up the adoption of cryptocurrencies around the world. It connects users of centralized exchanges with on-chain opportunities. SuperSwap, Velodrome, and the Tydro lending protocol powered by Aave are just a few of the apps that are growing on the chain.
raw.name: Ink
steps: Step 1: Create a Kraken Account: Sign up at Kraken and complete identity verification. Kraken Pro activity directly counts toward Ink points, so an active verified account is the most confirmed path to eligibility right now.

Step 2: Trade on Kraken Pro: Open Kraken Pro and start trading. Points are collected through activity on Kraken Pro, calculated and added every Monday, reflecting the previous week’s activity. For existing users, points started from April 6th, 2026. Boosts are limited-time ways to earn extra points, Deposit cash (2x points) Reactivation bonus (3x points) Set price alerts (Bonus boost)

Step 3: Set up Kraken Wallet and move funds to Ink: Download Kraken Wallet and switch to the Ink network. Because the wallet has first-party Ink support, moving assets from Kraken to Ink carries no withdrawal fee, and transfers are fast. Early Kraken Wallet users can start earning $INK points from day one by swapping tokens, buying NFTs, and interacting with Nado and Tydro directly inside the…

Step 4: Trade on Nado DEX: Visit the Nado DEX and execute trade perps using your bridged funds. Onchain trading activity on Nado earns Nado points and is also confirmed to be an eligibility criteria for the INK airdrop.
Step 5: Supply or Borrow on Tydro: Go to Tydro and supply assets to earn yield or borrow against collateral. Tydro activity is another confirmed eligibility criteria for the INK airdrop.

Step 6: Explore Featured Apps: Check the Ink homepage for featured dApps, including Velodrome, InkyPump, and GM check-ins. Interact regularly across the ecosystem. Breadth of activity across multiple apps tends to matter more than heavy use of a single one.
Step 7: Register a .ink Domain: Register a .ink domain through ZNS . Owning a domain ties your identity to the Ink ecosystem and adds another qualifying interaction.
Step 8: Send a GM on the Network: Send a GM to another user on Ink. Each GM counts as an additional transaction on the chain, contributing to your overall activity.
Step 9: Deploy a Smart Contract on Ink: Use OnChainGM to deploy a smart contract on Ink. This is a simple one-click deployment that registers a contract interaction on your address.
Step 10: Get the Ink Guild Role: Visit the Guild and complete the requirements to claim your Guild role. Guild roles often serve as eligibility checkpoints for airdrops.

Step 11: Mint the Ink Pass NFT: Sweep has launched public minting for the Ink Pass NFT , offering holders exclusive benefits across the Ink ecosystem. Mint your pass to secure potential additional airdrop eligibility.

raw.actions: Make Swaps to Collect XPs
raw.description:
Jumper Exchange is a multi-chain liquidity aggregator that brings together three types of liquidity sources: DEX aggregators, solvers, and cross-chain bridges. It makes trading easier by giving you a full order routing system, which saves you the time and effort of doing research, setting up, and keeping things running.
Jumper/LI.FI is the routing and execution layer that connects applications to on-chain liquidity across chains, bridges, DEXs, and solvers through a single integration. It powers Jumper Exchange, a multi-chain platform for bridging and swapping digital assets. Jumper combines liquidity from many decentralized exchanges and bridges to find the best trading paths across several blockchains.
Investors like Coinbase Ventures and DragonFly Capital have given LI.FI $52 million in funding.
raw.name: Jumper Exchange
steps: Step 1: Visit the Jumper Exchange: Go to the Jumper Exchange platform. This is the main interface for all swapping and bridging activity powered by LI.FI.
Step 2: Connect Your Wallet: Click “Connect Wallet” and link your preferred wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, or Rabby). Approve the connection request.

Step 3: Select a Source Chain and Token: Choose the blockchain you want to swap or bridge from (e.g., Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, Base) and select the token you wish to send. You can purchase assets from Binance if you need tokens to get started, or swap and bridge funds directly using the widget below.

Step 4: Select a Destination Chain and Complete the Swap: Choose your destination chain and token, then confirm the transaction. Jumper will automatically find the best route across available bridges and DEXs.

Step 5: Earn XP Through Activity: You will start earning XP automatically as you complete swaps and bridges. Higher volume and more frequent transactions contribute to greater XP accumulation. Check your XP balance on the Jumper XP dashboard .

Step 6: Complete Missions for Bonus XP: Navigate to the “Missions” section on Jumper Exchange. Complete the available missions to earn additional XP beyond standard swap rewards. Missions rotate periodically, so check back regularly for new opportunities.

Step 7: Bridge to Hyperliquid for Dual Eligibility: Use Jumper’s Hyperliquid integration to bridge tokens into the Hyperliquid ecosystem. This cross-chain bridging activity may qualify you for potential airdrops from both Jumper Exchange and Hyperliquid simultaneously.

步驟2：將您的錢包連線到鑄幣頁面：開啟Memebook鑄幣頁面，連線您剛剛注資的錢包，並簽署驗證訊息。始終使用同一個錢包，因為 XP 與地址而不是使用者名稱繫結。

步驟 4：鑄造您的 Memebook 通行證：青銅級是免費的，可讓您進入該應用程式。付費等級會提高您的 XP 乘數和每日限制，這在每個貼文中都會增加。通行證是靈魂繫結的，因此它會附著在鑄幣錢包上並且不能轉售。
第 5 步：安裝 Android 應用程式：從 Google Play 下載 Memebook 並使用持有 Pass 的錢包登入。沒有 iOS 版本，因此需要 Android 裝置來完成活動的應用程式內部分。

步驟 7：為創作者打賞並分享您的邀請碼：向您喜歡的貼文傳送 SOL 打賞，這是一項鏈上操作，計入您的活動。然後分享應用程式中的邀請連結，當您推薦的人鑄造通行證時即可賺取 XP。

raw.actions: Mint Your Memebook Pass, Install the App, Complete Social Tasks
raw.description: Memebook is a social app on Solana built around photos and short-form reels. The feed works like Instagram, but accounts are wallets rather than email signups: users post, like, comment, and send SOL tips to creators directly on-chain. Activity earns XP, and the team has said XP converts into $MBK utility once the token launches. Memebook closed a $1 million seed round backed by TOF Ventures in August 2026.
raw.name: Memebook
steps: Step 1: Fund a Solana Wallet: Install Phantom or Solflare and keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees, tips, and any paid Pass tier. You can buy SOL on Bybit and withdraw straight to your Solana address.

Step 2: Connect Your Wallet to the Mint Page: Open the Memebook mint page , connect the wallet you just funded, and sign the verification message. Use this same wallet throughout, since XP is tied to the address rather than a username.

Step 3: Verify Your X and Telegram Accounts: Link both accounts on the mint page. Verification is required before minting and includes following the Memebook X account and joining the Telegram channel.

Step 4: Mint Your Memebook Pass: Bronze is free and gets you into the app. Paid tiers raise your XP multiplier and daily limits, which compounds across every post. The Pass is soulbound, so it stays attached to the minting wallet and cannot be resold.

Step 5: Install the Android App: Download Memebook from Google Play and sign in with the wallet holding your Pass. There is no iOS build, so an Android device is required for the in-app half of the campaign.

Step 6: Post and Engage Daily: Publish photos or reels, like and comment on other creators, and complete the daily check-in. Spreading activity across days earns more than dumping the same volume into one session.

Step 7: Tip Creators and Share Your Invite Code: Send SOL tips to posts you like, which is an on-chain action and counts toward your activity. Then share your invite link from the app to earn XP when someone you referred mints a Pass.

Have three conversations with your Mind to unlock $5 in HelloMinds credits These credits work on the platform only and are not cash or a…

steps: 步驟 1：為錢包提供資金並橋接到 Ink：您需要 ETH 作為 Ink 氣體和 USDT0 進行交易或存款。在 Binance 上購買 ETH 和穩定幣，然後使用下面的網橋小工具或其他支援 Ink 的網橋將它們轉移到 Ink 網路。保留少量 ETH 餘額以支付交易費用。
步驟 2：建立您的 Nado 帳戶：前往 Nado 應用程式並連線與 EVM 相容的錢包，例如 MetaMask 或 Rabby。第二季向所有人開放，因此您無需推薦碼即可直接註冊。
步驟3：存入抵押品：將USDT0傳送至您的Nado帳戶作為保證金。統一的保證金制度讓一個餘額支援多個現貨和永續倉位，因此您不需要為每個市場單獨開設帳戶。
步驟 4：交易現貨和永續市場：在 Nado 市場上開倉以賺取積分。積分獎勵的是真正的市場參與而不是原始交易量，因此交易、作為掛單者發布限價訂單以及支援清算都很重要。清洗交易和自我配對可以減少或清除您那週的分配。
步驟 5：為 NLP 金庫提供流動性：將 USDT0 存入 NLP 金庫，根據每週週期內的平均比例份額賺取積分。金庫為訂單簿提供流動性，並賺取交易費用和清算收益的一部分，因此您可以在獲得積分的同時獲得收益。
步驟 6： 使用代幣化股票作為抵押品：存入 SPYx 或 QQQx，以在從一個投資組合進行交易時持有美國市場的現貨敞口。您也可以針對這些部位借入 USDT0 並開立 BTC、ETH 或 SOL 永續合約，因為 Nado 會在單一投資組合保證金下評估現貨餘額、永續合約部位和借入負債。瞭解如何在 Nado 上存入 xStocks。
第 7 步：推薦活躍交易者：在推薦頁面分享您的推薦連結。只有當您邀請的人實際進行交易時，您才能獲得推薦積分，因此獎勵會追蹤實際使用情況而不是註冊情況。
步驟 8：追蹤積分和交易等級：檢查積分頁面以監控您的每週積分、排名和交易等級。等級範圍從底部的微風到頂部的龍捲風，都會影響未來的 NLP 資格，因此每週持續的活動比單一大型課程更重要。完整的機制在文件中。

raw.actions: Deposit & Trade perps
raw.description:
Nado is a central-limit orderbook (CLOB) decentralized exchange built on the Ink blockchain, developed by the team behind Kraken. The platform combines spot and perpetual trading through a unified margin system, allowing traders to manage collateral dynamically across multiple positions.
Built on Ink, Nado leverages the blockchain’s infrastructure to deliver orderbook-based trading with multiple collateral options and margin trading capabilities. The platform targets traders looking for a comprehensive trading experience that includes both spot markets and leveraged perpetual positions on a single interface.
raw.name: Nado
steps: Step 1: Fund a Wallet and Bridge to Ink: You need ETH for Ink gas and USDT0 to trade or deposit. Buy ETH and stablecoins on Binance , then move them to the Ink network using the bridge widget below or another bridge that supports Ink. Keep a small ETH balance for transaction fees.
Step 2: Create Your Nado Account: Go to the Nado app and connect an EVM-compatible wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby. Season 2 opened to everyone, so you can sign up directly without a referral code.

Step 3: Deposit Collateral: Send USDT0 to your Nado account to use as margin. The unified margin system lets one balance support multiple spot and perpetual positions, so you do not need separate accounts for each market.

Step 4: Trade Spot and Perpetual Markets: Open positions across the Nado markets to earn points. Points reward genuine market participation rather than raw volume, so trading, posting limit orders as a maker, and supporting liquidations all count. Wash trading and self-matching can reduce or zero out your allocation for that week.

Step 5: Provide Liquidity to the NLP Vault: Deposit USDT0 into the NLP vault to earn points based on your average proportional share during each weekly epoch. The vault supplies liquidity to the orderbook and earns a cut of trading fees and liquidation proceeds, so you collect yield alongside points.

Step 6: Use Tokenized Equities as Collateral: Deposit SPYx or QQQx to hold spot exposure to US markets while trading from one portfolio. You can also borrow USDT0 against these positions and open BTC, ETH, or SOL perps, since Nado evaluates spot balances, perp positions, and borrowed liabilities under a single portfolio margin. Learn how to deposit xStocks on Nado .

Step 7: Refer Active Traders: Share your referral link from the Referrals page. You earn referral points only when the people you invite actually trade, so the rewards track real usage rather than sign-ups.

Step 8: Track Points and Trading Tier: Check the points page to monitor your weekly points, ranking, and Trading Tier. Tiers range from Breeze at the bottom to Tornado at the top and influence future NLP eligibility, so consistent weekly activity matters more than a single large session. Full mechanics are in the documentation .

PERPTools is a self-custodial perpetual futures DEX from the team behind DEXTools. It runs on Orderly Network ‘s shared orderbook, so orders fill against liquidity pooled across every Orderly-powered exchange.

Step 3: Trade Perpetuals: Open the trading terminal, pick a market, and place a market or limit order. Volume and open interest both feed your weekly score. Standard markets charge 0.01% for maker orders and 0.046% for taker orders.
Step 4: Trade Spot Markets: Switch to spot and swap between listed pairs. Spot volume earns Season 2 points, and PERPTools currently charges 0% fees on spot trades.

Step 5: Fund an AI Agent in AI Arena: Open AI Arena with a Solana wallet. Agents accept USDC only, and you have two ways in: Create your own agent: set its risk and leverage limits, describe the strategy, then deposit Deposit into an existing agent after checking its PnL and trade history Agent trading and agent deposits both earn points. Creating an agent without funding it earns nothing. Each…

Step 6: Share Your Referral Link: Copy your personal link from the Referral page. You receive points equal to 10% of what your referred users earn, plus a base 10% share of their trading fees paid in USDC.
Step 7: Check Your Weekly Points: Visit the Points page after each Friday distribution to see your allocation and rank.

steps: Step 1: Visit the Push Portal: Go to the Push Portal rewards page and log in with a wallet or a social account. If you farmed Season 1 or 2, use the same wallet so your earlier points carry over.
Step 2: Verify your social accounts: Follow PushChain on X and join the Push Chain Discord , then complete verification inside the portal. This unlocks the quest board and referral link.

Step 3: Claim testnet PC from the faucet: Click the wallet icon inside the portal to open the faucet and claim 1 free PC token. The faucet resets every 6 hours, so grab it a few times a day to keep enough gas for the onchain quests.

Step 4: Complete the universal app challenges: Work through the quests attached to each app in the weekly rotation: play, or predict, depending on the app. These challenges are the main XP source in Season 3.
Step 5: Check in daily: Hit the daily check-in whenever you open the portal. Streaks stack a bonus on top of the base reward, and a missed day resets it.
Step 6: Use the daily spin: The Spin 2 Win wheel pays out Rare Passes, testnet $PC, and other rewards once per day. It takes a few seconds and is one of the few pass sources outside of leveling.

Step 7: Collect Rare Passes: Stack as many Rare Passes as you can through level ups and spins. All passes get burned at TGE for a shot at a Shiny Pass, and the bigger your stash, the better your odds.

Step 8: Invite friends: Share your referral link from the portal. You earn 16% of the points your invites generate and another 8% from the people they invite. Extra invite slots unlock as your referrals reach level 7, so help your invites stay active.
Step 9: Climb the leaderboard: Leaderboards are live and track actual network usage. A higher rank heading into TGE positions you for a larger share of the season allocation.

Push Chain currently runs on testnet, with mainnet as the next milestone.

raw.description:
Raycash is a self-custodial money account for holding, sending, spending, and earning with stablecoins while balances and transaction amounts stay encrypted.
The app converts USDC or USDT into confidential versions using the Zama Protocol, which applies fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) so payments settle on Ethereum without putting the amounts on a public ledger. Users can top up with stablecoins, a bank transfer, or a card, then spend with the Raycard, use IBAN rails, and earn yield.

第二步：連線您的錢包：開啟您的個人資料並繫結您的錢包。 REP 支援每個帳戶、EVM 等約五個地址。使用歷史最悠久的錢包，因為空錢包不會產生任何成就。您僅簽署一條訊息來證明所有權，無需批准或轉讓。
步驟 3： 連結您的其他社交帳戶：從個人資料頁面新增 Telegram、Farcaster、Discord 和任何其他支援的平臺。每一項都擴大了您有資格獲得的成就範圍。
步驟 4： 領取您的成就：開啟成就清單並領取您有資格獲得的所有徽章。價值範圍從代表社交里程碑的幾百個 REP 點到代表最高百分位 DeFi 活動的 3,000 點。有些索賠會收取少量的鏈上費用，因此請在連線的錢包中保留一些相關的天然氣代幣。您可以在Bybit上購買並直接提取，或者轉移您已經...
步驟 5：設定您的 Remoji 排名：排名分為七個等級，從底部的朝聖者到頂部的 0.5% 等級。一旦您的徽章被認領，請在您的 REP 個人資料和 Telegram 上設定排名表情符號，它充當其他使用者在與您聯絡之前閱讀的訊號。

raw.actions: Link Your Social Accounts, Claim Achievements, Refer Users
raw.description: REP is a portable reputation layer that turns your existing wallet activity and social history into one trust profile you can carry between apps. Instead of starting from zero on every new platform, you connect accounts you already use and REP reads the public record: trades, liquidity positions, past airdrops, NFTs, and follower quality.
raw.name: REP
steps: Step 1: Log In With Your X Account: Go to the REP app and sign in with X. This becomes the anchor identity for your profile, and REP reads public metrics like follower quality to seed your first badges.

Step 2: Connect Your Wallets: Open your profile and bind your wallets. REP supports roughly five addresses per account, EVM and others. Use the wallets with the deepest history, since an empty wallet produces no achievements. You only sign a message to prove ownership, with no approvals or transfers.
Step 3: Link Your Other Social Accounts: Add Telegram, Farcaster, Discord, and any other supported platform from the profile page. Each one widens the pool of achievements you qualify for.

Step 4: Claim Your Achievements: Open the achievements list and claim every badge you qualify for. Values range from a few hundred REP points for social milestones up to 3,000 for top-percentile DeFi activity. Some claims charge a small on-chain fee, so keep a little of the relevant gas token in your connected wallet. You can buy it on Bybit and withdraw it directly, or move assets you already…

Step 5: Set Your Remoji Rank: Ranks run across seven tiers, from pilgrim at the bottom to the top 0.5% band. Once your badges are claimed, set the rank emoji on your REP profile and on Telegram, where it acts as the signal other users read before connecting with you.

Step 6: Browse Matches and Join Rooms: Open the Matches section to see communities your reputation qualifies you for. Some rooms ask for an email address. Join the ones relevant to your activity rather than every room on the list.

Step 7: Share Your Social Graph Invite Link: Grab your personal invite link from the Social Graph section and share it. Invites are weighted by who accepts them, so a handful of active wallets beats a long list of empty ones.

第 5 步：在主網上交易永續合約：在 RISEx 上進行真實交易。交易量很重要，但支付的費用、滑點、未平倉合約和持有時間也很重要，因此持有數天的頭寸可以與活躍的倒賣一起計算在內。

raw.actions: Sign Up, Enable Trading, Trade & Refer
raw.description: RISEx is a fully onchain spot and perpetuals exchange built on RISE Chain. The orderbook lives entirely onchain and updates in about 1 millisecond, so placing and cancelling orders feels closer to a centralized exchange than a typical DEX. RISE Labs has raised roughly $9.2 million , including a $3.2 million seed round and a later $4 million round from Galaxy Ventures. Vitalik Buterin, Sandeep Nailwal, Finality Capital, and Stani Kulechov are among the backers.
raw.name: RISEx
steps: Step 1: Visit the RISEx Website: Go to the RISEx platform . Signing up through an invite link is required, and this one gets you straight past the gate.
Step 2: Sign Up With Google or a Wallet: Create your account using a Google login or by connecting an EVM wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby.
Step 3: Deposit USDC: USDC is the collateral for all trading on RISEx. Use the Deposit window to fund your account.
Step 4: Open the Points Page and Enable Trading: Go to the Points section and enable trading for your account.

Step 5: Trade Perpetuals on Mainnet: Place real trades on RISEx. Volume matters, but so do fees paid, slippage, open interest, and hold time, so a position held for days can count alongside active scalping.
Step 6: Share Your Invite Code: Grab your referral code from the platform and share it. You earn an extra 10% of all the points your invitees generate.
Step 7: Track Your Points Weekly: Distributions settle every Tuesday at 14:00 UTC. Check the Points dashboard after each drop to see your balance and confirm your activity is registering.

steps: Step 1: Join the RWAPerp Waitlist: Go to the RWAPerp Waitlist , connect your X account (10 XP) and follow the official RWAPerp account (20 XP). Joining is free.

Step 2: Connect Wallets With Perp Trading History: Link up to three wallets you’ve used on perp DEXs like Hyperliquid , Aster or dYdX , signing once per wallet. Verification gives 20 XP, and past trading volume is worth up to 300 XP.

Step 3: Complete the Community Tasks: Finish the remaining waitlist tasks: Join the RWAPerp Discord (10 XP) Join the RWAPerp Telegram community (10 XP) Repost the designated campaign post (10 XP) Add your email address to receive the access notification

Step 4: Activate Your Early Access: Watch the waitlist page, RWAPerp’s X account and your inbox for your cohort notice, then activate before its deadline or your spot may be reassigned. An existing Early Access user can also invite you directly.

Step 5: Connect OKX Wallet to the RWAPerp App: Open the RWAPerp app , connect OKX Wallet (the trading wallet the docs currently support) and sign the message to create your account. The platform never takes custody of your funds.
Step 6: Deposit USDC: Positions use USDC on X Layer, and you need a little OKB for X Layer gas. Buy USDC on Bybit , then move it to the right network with the bridge widget below.

Step 7: Trade RWA Perpetuals: Open long or short positions on stocks, indices, commodities or crypto. Volume, fees paid and active trading days all count toward points. Use low leverage until you know how these markets move around closes and gaps.
Step 8: Invite Other Traders: Early Access users can invite up to 10 people, who get immediate Beta access and a 5% trading fee discount for their first 30 days.

steps: Step 1: Visit the Synthra App: Go to the Synthra app .

Step 3: Deposit Supported Coins: Deposit any of the supported stablecoins into your Synthra account. If you need USDC, you can buy it on Bybit . Stablecoins sitting on another network can be moved or swapped with the widget below before you deposit.

Step 4: Provide In-Range Liquidity: Add liquidity to a Synthra pool on Arc. This covers 80% of the daily points pool: Set a price range around the current price so the position stays active New net liquidity earns extra points for its first 7 days while in range Rebalance if the price leaves your range, since out-of-range positions stop qualifying as active liquidity

Step 5: Trade Spot and Perps: Swap tokens, including cross-chain routes, or open perpetual positions. Volume earns from the 15% trading share up to $100,000 per day, and anything above that cap adds no points.

Step 6: Share Your Referral Link: Copy your link from the Rewards & referrals section and send it to people who plan to use Synthra. Sign-ups alone earn nothing; you only receive referral points once invitees complete qualifying activity.

raw.actions: Trade perps & refer friends
raw.description:
Variational is a decentralized peer-to-peer trading protocol built on Arbitrum that specializes in perpetuals and generalized derivatives. The protocol provides infrastructure for P2P trading, clearing, and settlement, enabling secure bilateral trading of options, futures, perpetuals, and exotic derivatives. Unlike traditional derivatives platforms, Variational eliminates revenue leakage to third-party market makers by redirecting value directly back to users through its unique rewards system.
The protocol’s flagship application, Omni, positions itself as “the most rewarding place to trade perps” by offering zero-fee trading while users earn benefits including loss refunds, spread discounts, and platform credits from their normal trading activity. This stands in stark contrast to other exchanges that typically charge 0.05% to 0.6% per trade. Omni aggregates liquidity from centralized exchanges, decentralized exchanges, DeFi protocols, and OTC sources through the Omni Liquidity Provider (OLP), which has generated yields as high as 369% annualized over the last 90 days for community depositors.
Variational has secured $61.8 million in funding from prominent investors including Bain Capital Crypto, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), Coinbase Ventures, Mirana Ventures, Caladan, and Zoku Ventures.
raw.name: Variational
steps: Step 1: Get an Omni Access Code: Omni is in private beta, so you need a whitelisted address or referral code to create an account. Request one in the official Variational Discord first.
Step 2: Connect Your Wallet: Visit the Omni trading platform and connect an Arbitrum wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby. Enter your access code to finish creating the account.
Step 3: Deposit USDC on Arbitrum: USDC on Arbitrum is the only collateral Omni uses.

Step 4: Trade Perpetual Contracts: Open long or short positions across the available markets. Points track cumulative volume rather than profit, so steady trading matters more than any single winning trade.

Step 5: Claim Loss Refunds: After closing a losing trade, open the Rewards page and check the Loss Refund section. Eligible trades have roughly a 1-5% chance of a refund, with better odds at higher tiers.

Step 6: Refer Other Traders: Share your referral code to earn USDC rewards from your referrals’ activity, plus 1 bonus point for every 10 points they accumulate. Roughly $1 million in cumulative volume is needed to enable referrals.

New tokens start on a bonding curve, where the price rises gradually as people buy. Once a token hits its market cap target, it graduates and its liquidity moves to a DEX. The testnet went live in August 2026.
raw.name: Vibe Vibe
steps: Step 1: Claim Test ETH from the Faucet: Open the Robinhood Chain Testnet Faucet , enter your wallet address, and request test ETH. You need it for gas and for trading on the testnet.
Step 2: Connect Your Wallet to Vibe Vibe: Go to the Vibe Vibe testnet and connect your EVM wallet. If your wallet asks you to add or switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet, approve it.

Step 3: Create a Testnet Token: Click the launch option and fill in the details: Token name and ticker Token image (required) A short description of the project Put some effort into it, because the team says quality launches count.
Step 4: Buy and Sell Testnet Tokens: Trade tokens launched by other users. Buy early on the bonding curve and sell into strength, since high PnL is one of the listed eligibility criteria.
Step 5: Join the Telegram Raiding Channel: Join the Vibe Vibe Telegram and take part in raids on X. You need a verified X account, and the top 250 raiders qualify for a free Vibe Vibers NFT.

Step 6: Apply for a Vibe Vibers Whitelist: Follow the Vibe Vibers page for mint updates. Creators who make memes or other content can apply for collab spots when the form opens, with free mint whitelists awarded based on quality.

步驟 5：加入 Voice Pulse 活動：參加 Voice Pulse 活動以獲得額外的影響力和獎勵。本輪於9月1日結束，請在截止日期前完成任務。
步驟 6：完成 Layer3 VOICE 活動：前往 Layer3 上單獨的 VOICE 活動，該活動帶有廣告宣傳的 2,000 美元獎勵池。完成列出的任務即可獲得分享資格。
第七步：進入夥伴群集：加入Social Camp內的夥伴群集。這些來自合作夥伴專案的捆綁任務並帶有自己的 USDT 和 NFT 池以及 CLOUT。
步驟 8：透過 FRENS 邀請好友：分享您的 FRENS 邀請連結。您將獲得永久 10% 的受邀者產生的 CLOUT 提升，因此早期邀請者可以在活動的其餘部分繼續付費。
analysis.summary:
VOICE 是 Solana 上的 OpinionFi 平臺，將意見轉化為鏈上資產。使用者建立民意調查，對辯論和熱門話題進行投票，並透過參與獲得獎勵，無論他們站在哪一邊。主應用程式是圍繞 $VOICE 代幣構建的：它需要持有 VOICE 才能投票，而投票會凍結代幣，這些代幣會在選民和投票建立者之間分配每日獎勵池。
完整的平臺尚未推出。目前正在執行的是 Social Camp，這是一個預發布中心，使用者可以在其中完成任務、進行民意調查並在發布前建立一個名為 CLOUT 的分數。 VOICE 已與 30 多個合作夥伴專案開展活動，其合約由 Nethermind 審核

raw.actions: Sign Up, Complete Core Tasks and Mint VOICY Pass
raw.description:
VOICE is an OpinionFi platform on Solana that turns opinions into on-chain assets. Users create polls, vote on debates and hot takes, and earn rewards for taking part, whichever side they land on. The main app is built around the $VOICE token: it requires holding VOICE to vote, and votes freeze tokens that feed a daily reward pool split between voters and poll creators.
The full platform has not launched yet. What is live is Social Camp, a pre-launch hub where users complete quests, vote in polls, and build a score called CLOUT ahead of release. VOICE has run campaigns with more than 30 partner projects, and its contracts were audited by Nethermind
raw.name: VOICE
steps: Step 1: Visit the VOICE Social Camp: Go to the VOICE Social Camp page. This is the pre-launch hub where quests, leaderboards, and CLOUT tracking live.
Step 2: Sign in with your X account: Connect your X account, since most quests track posts, quotes, and mentions there. You can also continue with a Google account or a Solana wallet.

Step 3: Complete Core, Daily, and Burst tasks: Clear the Core tasks first, then return for the Daily set. Burst tasks are shorter, higher-value entries announced in the VOICE Discord , so keep an eye there for drops.
Step 4: Vote in polls and Opinion Cup battles: Cast votes on active polls and in Opinion Cup matchups. Each vote earns CLOUT, and the Cup runs creator battles with USDT prize pools on top.
Step 5: Join the Voice Pulse campaign: Enter the Voice Pulse campaign for extra CLOUT and rewards. This round closes on September 1, so finish its tasks before the deadline.
Step 6: Complete the Layer3 VOICE campaign: Head to the separate VOICE campaign on Layer3 , which carries an advertised $2,000 reward pool. Complete the listed quests to qualify for a share.
Step 7: Enter partner clusters: Join the partner clusters inside Social Camp. These bundle quests from partner projects and carry their own USDT and NFT pools alongside CLOUT.
Step 8: Invite friends through FRENS: Share your FRENS invite link. You earn a permanent 10% boost on the CLOUT your invitees generate, so early invites keep paying through the rest of the campaign.

steps: 步驟 1：加入 Wick 等候名單：前往 Wick 等候名單並連線您的 EVM 錢包。批准連線請求，頁面將您的錢包新增到列表中。
步驟 2：在 X 上分享 Wick：完成 X 分享任務，從您的帳戶發布有關 Wick 的資訊。當您在那裡時，請關注 X 上的 Wick，因為團隊在那裡發布了其發布新聞。
步驟 3：加入 Wick Discord：加入 Wick Discord 以關注公告並提出問題。
步驟 4： 領取您的推薦連結：開啟候補名單頁面上的推薦部分，輸入姓名，然後領取您的個人推薦連結。此選項僅在您的錢包在步驟 1 中註冊後才能解鎖。
步驟 5：探索 Wick 檔案：通讀 Wick 文件，瞭解 wAMM、wLIT、wLLP 和 sWICK 的工作原理。提前瞭解產品有助於您在 Lighter EVM 上開設存款後快速採取行動。
analysis.summary:
Wick 是一個專注於現實世界金融的 DeFi 協議，擁有代幣化股票、選擇權和指數籃子市場。
該協議有四種產品。 wAMM 是一個基於倉的交易所，其中每個價格倉均以固定價格進行交易，在市場波動期間動態費用會上漲，並與限價單、選擇權和指數市場掛鉤。 Wick 也執行自己的套利和做市策略。 Wick 的產品已記錄在案，但尚未上線，等待名單是目前唯一的途徑。

raw.actions: Join Waitlist, Claim Referral Link, Invite Users
raw.description:
Wick is a DeFi protocol focused on real-world finance, with markets for tokenized stocks, options, and index baskets.
The protocol has four products. wAMM is a bin-based exchange where each price bin trades at a fixed price, with dynamic fees that rise during volatile markets and hooks for limit orders, options, and index markets. Wick also runs its own arbitrage and market-making strategies. Wick’s products are documented but not live yet, and the waitlist is currently the only way in.
raw.name: Wick
steps: Step 1: Join the Wick Waitlist: Go to the Wick waitlist and connect your EVM wallet. Approve the connection request, and the page adds your wallet to the list.
Step 2: Share Wick on X: Complete the X share task to post about Wick from your account. Follow Wick on X while you’re there, since the team posts its launch news there.
Step 3: Join the Wick Discord: Join the Wick Discord to follow announcements and ask questions.

Step 4: Claim Your Referral Link: Open the referral section on the waitlist page, enter a name, and claim your personal referral link. This option only unlocks after your wallet is registered in Step 1.
Step 5: Explore the Wick Docs: Read through the Wick docs to learn how wAMM, wLIT, wLLP, and sWICK work. Knowing the products in advance helps you act quickly once deposits open on Lighter EVM.

步驟 2：加入 Worldie Discord：使用搶先體驗頁面上的 Discord 圖示加入官方 Worldie Discord。一旦您進入伺服器，就會新增 +400 世界積分獎勵。

步驟 5：分享您的連結：將連結傳送給將使用社交交易應用程式的朋友和社群。推薦僅在受邀使用者註冊並連線 X 和錢包後才算數，因此在分享時請提及這兩個要求。
步驟 6： 追蹤您在排行榜上的排名：點選「檢視排行榜」即可檢視您的世界積分和位置。全球、朋友、本週和所有時間標籤可讓您將自己與每個人或僅與您自己的網路進行比較。
analysis.summary:
Worldie 是一個瀏覽器原生社交網路和啟動板，其中加密貨幣市場（無論是代幣還是個人）都可以作為社交物件。 Worldie 空投活動目前屬於搶先體驗等候名單，使用者可以在計劃的 $WORLDIE 代幣之前收集 World Points。
每個市場都在本地軌道上啟動，並開放到一個持久的場景，一個創造者、持有者和交易者見面和交易的社交空間。

raw.actions: Join Waitlist & Discord, Claim Link & Refer Users
raw.description:
Worldie is a browser-native social network and launchpad where crypto markets, whether for a token or a person, work as social objects. The Worldie airdrop campaign is currently an early access waitlist where users collect World Points ahead of the planned $WORLDIE token.
Each market launches on native rails and opens into a persistent Scene, a social space where creators, holders, and traders meet and trade.
raw.name: Worldie
steps: Step 1: Visit the Worldie Early Access Page: Go to the Worldie early access page and click “Join early.” Sign in with your X account or Google.
Step 2: Join the Worldie Discord: Use the Discord icon on the early access page to join the official Worldie Discord. The +400 World Points bonus is added once you’re in the server.

Step 3: Connect Your X Account and Wallet: Open the “Get your invite” panel and connect X (if you signed in with Google) along with a wallet. Connecting both locks your referral link. There is no deposit step.
Step 4: Claim Your Invite Link: Claim your personal invite link from the same panel. Worldie ties the link to your name.

Step 5: Share Your Link: Send the link to friends and communities that would use a social trading app. A referral only counts after the invited user signs up and connects both X and a wallet, so mention both requirements when you share it.

Step 6: Track Your Rank on the Leaderboard: Click “See the board” to check your World Points and position. Global, Friends, This Week, and All Time tabs let you compare yourself against everyone or just your own network.
